verdict.rationale: Authenticating through an enterprise identity provider or a cloud platform (such as SSO or cloud-provider credentials for model access) is a fair question for an AI coding CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents local models via Ollama, OpenAI-compatible APIs, and configuration through switches, YAML files or environment variables. None of these is an enterprise-identity or cloud-platform authentication capability.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
